002c9507fffe090b.question: Which privacy law applies to what booking keeps, in New York, and what does it require of booking and of the privacy notice (R6, R10)? Background read on 2026-10-20, for the adviser to confirm, not settled: HIPAA binds a provider that sends claims or other standard transactions electronically, so a clinic paid only by its patients may fall outside it unless it does so for anything, e-prescribing or a laboratory included; New York's SHIELD Act asks for reasonable security of the private information it keeps and notice of a breach, and was read as covering medical information since 2025; a New York health information privacy act was vetoed in December 2025 and a revised bill was pending in 2026; tracking scripts on a booking page are where federal guidance has been strictest.
002c9507fffe090b.why: booking takes a person's details for a medical appointment, and the law decides how they are kept, which tools the website may use on the booking pages, and what the notice must say

0944af9ff52e5182.question: Which rules on health advertising apply to what the website says about the services and about longevity (R2, R4)? Background read on 2026-10-20, for the adviser to confirm, not settled: New York's Education Law 6530(27) and the Regents' rule 8 NYCRR 29.1 forbid a physician's advertising that is false or misleading, guarantees a result, or claims what cannot be substantiated, allow a patient's testimonial only with their written consent and the rule's conditions, and ask that a copy of each advertisement be kept for a year after it last appears; the FTC asks that a health claim rest on competent and reliable scientific evidence.
0944af9ff52e5182.why: a claim the rules do not allow puts the clinic at risk, the longevity wording is where one is likeliest, and the staff change the words themselves (R13), so the rules may also decide who approves a change and what is kept of it

54ca0fb2e33a7740.name: Book an appointment
54ca0fb2e33a7740.purpose: A visitor books an appointment type with a doctor at a free time, signing in or creating an account on the way, and has it confirmed on the next screen.
54ca0fb2e33a7740.steps: 1. The visitor chooses an appointment type and sees its price; booking asks for no medical details, and says it is not for emergencies. SC8, R6, R7, R11 2. They choose a doctor who gives the type, or any, and a day; booking shows the free times, or, with none that day, the nearest days that have one. SC8, R14, R6 3. They choose a time and Continue; Continue with no time asks for one. SC8, R6 4. Signed out, they sign in, and the time is kept. SC9, R16, R6 5. New to NovaLife, they create an account with their name, date of birth, email, phone and a password, and the time is kept. SC21, R16, R6 6. They check the type, the doctor, the time and the price, which they pay themselves at the visit, and book. SC10, R6, R7 7. If the time was just booked by someone else, nothing is booked, and the nearest free times show. SC10, R6 8. If the booking fails, nothing is booked, what was chosen is kept, and they try again. SC10, R6 9. The next screen confirms it: the type, the doctor, the day and the time. SC11, R6

d33942005ee29471.name: Button
d33942005ee29471.purpose: What a person presses to do something: book, save, sign in, cancel. One primary button per screen or part, for the step that moves the work on; secondary for the other choices; small inside a row of a table or a list.
d33942005ee29471.rules: - At least 44 pixels high, 32 when small, and never narrower than its words. - It says the verb, in sentence case: Book, Save, Cancel -- never OK. - A link that only leads somewhere stays a link; a button does something. - Its look is the proposal of the foundations, 2026-10-20, to be changed with them. (foundations)

variants.when: the main step of a screen or a part
a darker teal: it can be pressed
a teal ring two pixels outside it
while what it started is under way, and it cannot be pressed twice
a choice beside the primary one
in a row of a table or a list

d35e3505d5e9cabe.name: Field
d35e3505d5e9cabe.purpose: Where a person writes or chooses something: a name, a date, an appointment type. Its label always stands above it, and what is wrong with it is said beneath it.
d35e3505d5e9cabe.rules: - The label above the field, semibold, in the product's words; never a placeholder in its place. - 44 pixels high, and no wider than 420 pixels, or 720 for a text that runs long. - What is required is said in the label, (required), and what is optional, (if they have one). - Its look is the proposal of the foundations, 2026-10-20, to be changed with them. (foundations)

variants.when: being written in: a teal ring
refused: a red edge, and the reason beneath it, C8
fixed, as a doctor's own name on SC16

e5962d8f802bb47b.name: A page for each of the four services
e5962d8f802bb47b.statement: The website shall give each of NovaLife's four services -- general medical care; prevention and early detection; longevity and healthy aging; high-tech, personalized healthcare -- a page of its own that says what the service covers, who it is for and how to start it.

e9c8b33a4aff4603.name: Book an appointment online
e9c8b33a4aff4603.statement: When a signed-in patient chooses an appointment type and a doctor's free time, the website shall book that time and confirm the booking on the next screen.

eb11bc00524c1acb.name: Motion
eb11bc00524c1acb.says: | What moves | Duration and easing | |---|---| | the colour of a button under the pointer | 150ms, ease-out | | anything else | none: a clinic's website should feel calm, and someone who asks for less motion gets none at all |

ec63e49b27622aed.address: /set-password?link={link}, the address the link in the email opens

data.what it shows or changes: The account the link was sent for, and the new password.

ec63e49b27622aed.name: Set a password
ec63e49b27622aed.purpose: A new member of staff, or a member of staff or a patient who asked to reset theirs, sets a password from the link they were sent, and signs in with it.
ec63e49b27622aed.reached by: the link in the email sent when an administrator adds a member of staff (R19), when a member of staff asks to reset at staff sign-in (R12), or when a patient asks to reset at sign-in (R16)

states.what it shows: The two fields blank, and whose account it is (R19).
The two passwords differ: element 5, nothing set.
The password cannot be set: element 10.
While setting it, Set password says Setting… and cannot be pressed twice.
Set: element 7, and Sign in, element 8 (R19, R16).
Set password is always enabled.
The link is the right to set it; one that no longer works is the expired state.
A link used already, or too old: element 9.
A button darkens under the pointer; a touch screen has nothing in its place, and a button is at least 44 pixels high.
Tab reaches each field and the button in reading order; the focus shows as a clear outline; Enter does what the button says; a message that appears is announced.
At 375 pixels every field takes the full width.
Its address is the one in the link, and it needs no signing in (R19, R16); back returns to the page before; a reload keeps the page and what it shows.
Whoever has a link the website sent; nobody else can reach an account by it (R19, R16).

a link used already or too old is opened

variants.what differs, and for whom: ?as=patient: a patient's reset, whose Sign in leads to SC9.

ec63e49b27622aed.who: whoever has the link the website sent

ef0b7922be09ff39.name: Choose NovaLife
ef0b7922be09ff39.purpose: A visitor who has heard of NovaLife finds out what it is, what each service covers and costs, who works there and how to become a patient, and goes on to book.
ef0b7922be09ff39.steps: 1. The visitor opens the website and reads the clinic's name, tagline, mission and central idea. SC1, R1 2. They choose a service, and read what it covers, who it is for, and its appointment types with their prices, which patients pay themselves. SC2, R2, R7 3. They read how NovaLife differs from the traditional approach, and its vision with its limit. SC3, R3, R4 4. They see the clinicians who work there. SC4, R8 5. They read how to become a patient, what happens at the first visit and what to bring. SC5, R9 6. They find the hours, the address and the phone. SC6, R5 7. They phone instead: the front desk books for them, F4. This step is outside the website. 8. They choose Book this on an appointment type, and booking opens with it chosen, F2. SC8, R6

f02825a2df4b38fc.name: Layout
f02825a2df4b38fc.says: | Rule | Value | |---|---| | the grid | one column of content, whose cards wrap in rows, each at least 220px wide | | the breakpoints | 640px: below it, the header's pages move to a row of their own, headings shrink, tables scroll in their own box | | the page's width | 1120px at most, centred; the header, the home page's opening and the footer run the whole width | | the page's margins | 24px each side; 16px below 640px | | a form | its fields no wider than 420px, one under another, each label above its field |

f548e65f585d1d5b.name: Staff change what the website says
f548e65f585d1d5b.statement: The website shall let a signed-in administrator change the text and pictures of every page, the services and their appointment types, the opening hours, the prices and the team, and show each change to visitors once it is saved.

f8944d750b5f9f39.name: Privacy
f8944d750b5f9f39.statement: The website shall show, on a page reached from every page and from booking, what it keeps about a visitor, why, who reads it and for how long.
